results.title: SPG-302 preserves retinal function in diabetic mice
results.description: Researchers from Spinogenix Inc. evaluated SPG-302 (tazbentetol), a synaptogenic agent, in db/db mice, a type 2 diabetes model characterized by leptin receptor deficiency and diabetes-associated retinal pathology.

results.title: Vaxthera to license Codagenix’s Syn17D-YF yellow fever vaccine
results.description: Vaxthera SAS and Codagenix Inc. have signed an agreement on terms for Vaxthera to exclusively license Codagenix’s Syn17D-YF (CDX-470), a fully synthetic yellow fever vaccine candidate designed for modern cell-culture manufacturing.

results.title: Rubedo’s RLS-1496 to enter clinic in new indication
results.description: Rubedo Life Sciences Inc. has announced a new clinical study of RLS-1496, a GPX4 modulator, in patients with androgenetic alopecia (AGA). The trial will begin next month, with initial data expected in the first half of next year.
